lesson.title: Perimeter vs area
lesson.html: Perimeter = distance around. Area = space inside, measured in square units (units²).

lesson.title: Area formulas
lesson.html: Parallelogram A = b·h · Triangle A = ½·b·h · Trapezoid A = ½(b₁ + b₂)·h · Circle A = πr²

lesson.title: Circles
lesson.html: π = circumference ÷ diameter ≈ 3.14. Diameter = 2 × radius. C = πd.

lesson.title: Triangles
lesson.html: Angles add to 180°. The two smaller sides must add to MORE than the largest side.
